name: RevenueCat (mobile)
description: In-app purchases and subscriptions for iOS + Android. Handles receipt validation, entitlements, and analytics.
postInstallNotes:
1. Call `configureRevenueCat(user.id)` once at app start (e.g. in `_layout.tsx`).
2. Expose the iOS + Android keys to Expo as `EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_API_KEY` and `EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY` in your `app.json` `extra` block or `.env`.
3. Configure products and entitlements in the RevenueCat dashboard before testing.
